answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by tying economic weight to audited work history rather than self-declared identity. An agent's influence grows only when established peers countersign its completed tasks, and random spot audits re-run samples of its claimed work. A Sybil attacker staging a summit of fakes must produce genuinely useful output for every identity, and any caught inconsistency slashes the whole cluster. Fabricated histories sink to the shale layer, visible but weightless, while only lotus-layer agents with clean audited records can move funds.
